title: the ranking of the deployment candidates of D4 (champion, recall, fast, fast_recall, control) is the same in Boston and in Singapore

a.recipe: analysis script temp/loop20/e252_gt_offset.py on the cached raw outputs of fast_recall, recall, fast, control, champion: per-city pooled metrics, frames of boston-seaport

c.recipe: the same models, frames of singapore-onenorth

rule.note: read from the printout per city: the ranking by Q of the five candidates must agree between the cities up to the band 0.010; a pair whose order flips by more than the band is reported as city-dependent evidence for D4
